paragraphs.text: Imskir Iron-Eater is an demon from an unknown plane, likely Kaldheim .

Imskir debuted as a character in Modern Horizons 3 as a demon with affinity for artifacts . Based on its appearance, it may be from Immersturm on Kaldheim . It has red eyes, sharp teeth, wears a metal helmet, has a long beard, and two horns on the sides of its head. It can survive various swords stabbing into it.
